documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter And Six Months Ended September 30, 2026; And Consider The Declaration Of Interim Dividend, If Any, For The Financial Year 2026-27.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Steel Strips Wheels Limited reported a healthy Q1 FY27 performance with revenue of INR1,509 crores, marking a 27% year-on-year growth. Standalone EBITDA with other income increased by 32% year-on-year to INR165.17 crores, driven by favorable product mix, operating leverage, and input price increases from OEMs. The profit after tax grew 43% year-on-year to INR71.51 crores. Management remains optimistic about achieving a top-line growth of 20% plus and increasing EBITDA per wheel for FY27. Steel Strips Wheels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, highlighting revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company targets a top line growth of 20% plus for FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our outlook for FY27, targeting a top line growth of 20% plus.

guidance.claim: Management targets increasing EBITDA per wheel to more than INR310 through the current financial year.
guidance.quote: We remain focused on enhancing profitability by increasing our EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter witnessed healthy momentum across alloy wheels, tractor wheels, and commercial vehicle segments supported by improved domestic demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The quarter witnessed healthy momentum across alloy wheels, tractor wheels, commercial vehicle segments, supported by improved domestic demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for exports has started showing recovery with improved business momentum and healthy traction from existing and newly nominated customers.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for the exports have started showing recovery yielding to positive results and improved business momentum. We continue to witness healthy traction from both existing and newly nominated customers.

demand_outlook.claim: The commercial vehicles segment witnessed gradual improvement supported by replacement demand, infrastructure-led investments, and improving freight movement.
demand_outlook.quote: The Commercial Vehicles segment also witnessed gradual improvement, supported by replacement demand, infrastructure-led investments and improving freight movement.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the medium-term outlook for commercial vehicles supported by increased government spending and improving economic activity.
demand_outlook.quote: While industry demand continues to remain uneven across certain categories, we remain optimistic about the medium-term outlook supported by increased government spending and improving economic activity.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up two manufacturing facilities in Bhuj comprising an aluminium wheel plant with an annual capacity of 1.2 million wheels and an aluminium knuckles facility with an annual capacity of 1.1 million units.
capex_expansion.quote: Now as already conveyed, we are setting up two manufacturing facilities in Bhuj. The first is an aluminium wheel plant with an annual capacity of 1.2 million wheels, while the second is an aluminium knuckles facility with an annual capacity of 1.1 million units.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial production at the Bhuj aluminium segment facilities is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We will be at about 6.2 million wheels in the aluminium segment and trial production is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex planned for the current year includes INR420 crores for the Bhuj plant expansion and INR80 crores for replacement and other plant capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Total capex, which we are planning in the current year is from the Bhuj plant where we are expanding our alloy wheel capacity by 1.2 million and knuckles capacity 0.6 million. And the total capex in both these are around INR420 crores. And as conveyed in last call, we are also doing some replacement and other plant capex of around INR80 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is undertaking a brownfield expansion to spend about INR150 crores to set up an agricultural and passenger car wheel manufacturing line.
capex_expansion.quote: So in line with that, we are going to spend about INR150 crores to set up this line and it's a Brownfield expansion. It's not a Greenfield expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: Net capex of INR 196 crores was incurred through FY26 towards incremental capacity expansion, largely focused on aluminium wheels and aluminium knuckles.
capex_expansion.quote: Net Capex of INR 196 Crs. was incurred through FY26 towards incremental capacity expansion, largely focused on aluminium wheels and aluminium knuckles.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA with other income for the quarter increased by 32% year-on-year to INR165.17 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Standalone EBITDA with other income for the quarter increased by 32% Y-o-Y and stood at INR165.17 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per wheel for the current quarter stands at INR314 compared to INR262 in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA per wheel for current quarter stands at INR314 per wheel as compared to INR262 per wheel in the Quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Margin percentages expanded by 40 bps driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, a favorable product mix, increasing share of premium products, and cost optimization initiatives.
margins_costs.quote: Margin percentages expanded during the quarter by 40 bps, driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, a favourable product mix and an increasing share of premium products and continued cost optimization initiatives across manufacturing facilities.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 43% year-on-year to INR71.51 crores with PAT margin improving to 4.7%.
margins_costs.quote: The profit after tax grew 43% Y-o-Y to INR71.51 crores with PAT margin improving to 4.7%.

margins_costs.claim: Higher utilization across all plants continues to improve operating leverage and supports margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Higher utilization across all our plant continues to improve operating leverage and supports margin expansion.

orders_capacity.claim: The aluminium knuckle order book is almost completely sold out, and the business is running at 100% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: And our expansion in Bhuj has become extremely important and necessary. And it's the perfect timing for us because that order book is almost completely sold out. So whatever I'm planning to produce in Bhuj, that's been sold out.

orders_capacity.claim: All business units are running at more than 95% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: If you really ask me, all my business units are running at more than 95% utilization.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted the war in West Asia and volatility in commodity prices as external challenges during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the war in West Asia and the volatility in commodity prices especially, our business has continued to demonstrate resilience across key segments.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry demand continues to remain uneven across certain categories.
risks_headwinds.quote: While industry demand continues to remain uneven across certain categories, we remain optimistic about the medium-term outlook supported by increased government spending and improving economic activity.

management_commitments.claim: Trial production at the Bhuj aluminium wheel and knuckles manufacturing facilities is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We will be at about 6.2 million wheels in the aluminium segment and trial production is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a top line growth of 20% plus for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our outlook for FY27, targeting a top line growth of 20% plus.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets enhancing profitability by increasing EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We remain focused on enhancing profitability by increasing our EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management is very optimistic to commercialize the agricultural and passenger car wheel brownfield expansion before the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we are very optimistic to commercialize it before the end of this calendar year, definitely.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims over the next 10 years to sell more wheels in the export market than in India.
management_commitments.quote: So the next 10 years, we want to sell more wheels in the export market than we sell in India.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
